list.en: There are long waiting lists to ensure that a new customer won't overload the local network, and in some parts of the United States, these waiting lists stretch to eight years, which is eight years too long if you're a technology company racing to build the next generation of AI.
list.zh: 排队等待的名单很长，以确保新客户不会使当地网络过载，而在美国某些地区，排队时间长达八年，对于一家竞相开发下一代人工智能的科技公司来说，八年实在太漫长了。

list.en: There are long waiting lists to ensure that a new customer won't overload the local network, and in some parts of the United States, these waiting lists stretch to eight years, which is eight years too long if you're a technology company racing to build the next generation of AI.

lighter.en: And regulators in the US have started treating fusion as a properly separate category from traditional nuclear power, with lighter rules, because a fusion reactor can't melt down the way a fission reactor can.
lighter.zh: 美国的监管机构也已开始将核聚变视为与传统核电完全不同的独立类别，适用的法规更为宽松，因为聚变反应堆不会像裂变反应堆那样发生堆芯熔毁。

living.en: A person living in an industrial city would be eating food that had traveled hundreds of kilometers and had been processed by people they never met.
living.zh: 一个生活在工业城市的人，吃的食物可能已经旅行了数百公里，并由他们从未见过的人加工过。

living.en: Instead of living close to farmland and producing their own food or buying local food from their neighbors, people needed to depend on shops and markets for their meals.
living.zh: 人们不再居住在农田附近并自己生产食物或从邻居那里购买本地食物，而是需要依靠商店和市场来解决他们的饭菜。

limited.en: And because working-class people had limited incomes, the quality of the food was not the priority.
limited.zh: 而且由于工人阶级收入有限，食物的质量不是优先考虑的。

limited.en: What this means is that an entire generation of British people grew up in a society that had experienced food scarcity and limited food choices.
limited.zh: 这意味着整整一代英国人是在一个经历过食物匮乏和有限食物选择的社会中长大的。

limit.en: Food rationing means limiting the foods available.
limit.zh: 食物配给意味着限制可获得的食物。
